description:
Title: App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run

If you want to participate at the Vienna Night Run, you need to select a starting block first.
After that, you run for 5km and measure the time.
If you can do it in less than 25 minutes, you are good.
If not, you need to train and check until you have achieved this goal.
After that, you can get your starting number.
Depending on when your work day ends, you have to find out whether you can go there from home, or need to leave directly from work.
If more than one hour is left between your starting time and the end of your workday, you can go there from home.
Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

Some of the above information you have to enter into the app, some of the information is collected by fitness gadgets.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ViennaNightRun">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Participant" name="Participant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Participation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunFiveKm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Qualified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Train</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckWorkdayTiming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RouteChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RouteMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NightRunSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunNightRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DrinkWhileRunning</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NightRunJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FinalTimeReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FitnessGadget" name="Fitness gadget">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeasureFiveKmTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Participation" name="Decide to participate">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectBlock_EnterInformation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInformation" name="Enter information into the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectBlock_EnterInformation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterInformation_RunFiveKm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RunFiveKm" name="Run 5 km">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterInformation_RunFiveKm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Train_RunFiveKm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunFiveKm_MeasureTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_MeasureFiveKmTime" name="Measure 5 km time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunFiveKm_MeasureTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MeasureTime_Qualified</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Qualified" name="Under 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotQualified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MeasureTime_Qualified</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Qualified</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotQualified</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Qualified" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Qualified" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">runningTimeMinutes < 25</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotQualified" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Qualified" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Train" name="Train">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotQualified</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Train_RunFiveKm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Qualified</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GetNumber_CheckTiming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckWorkdayTiming" name="Find out time between workday end and starting time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GetNumber_CheckTiming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckTiming_RouteChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RouteChoice" name="More than one hour until starting time?" default="Flow_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckTiming_RouteChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHome" name="More than one hour" sourceRef="Gateway_RouteChoice" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hoursBetween(workdayEnd, startingTime) > 1</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to the Night Run from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Home_RouteMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" name="One hour or less" sourceRef="Gateway_RouteChoice" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Work_RouteMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RouteMerge" name="Route selected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Home_RouteMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Work_RouteMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RouteMerge_NightRunSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NightRunSplit" name="Run and drink at the same time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RouteMerge_NightRunSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NightRunSplit_Run</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NightRunSplit_Drink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run at the Vienna Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NightRunSplit_Run</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run_NightRunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NightRunSplit_Drink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Drink_NightRunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NightRunJoin" name="Running and drinking complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run_NightRunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Drink_NightRunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NightRunJoin_CollectFinalTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectFinalTime" name="Collect final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NightRunJoin_CollectFinalTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectFinalTime_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectFinalTime_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveFinalTime_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalTimeReceived" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveFinalTime_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectBlock" sourceRef="Start_Participation" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectBlock_EnterInformation" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Task_EnterInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInformation_RunFiveKm" sourceRef="Task_EnterInformation" targetRef="Task_RunFiveKm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunFiveKm_MeasureTime" sourceRef="Task_RunFiveKm" targetRef="Task_MeasureFiveKmTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeasureTime_Qualified" sourceRef="Task_MeasureFiveKmTime" targetRef="Gateway_Qualified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Train_RunFiveKm" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Task_RunFiveKm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GetNumber_CheckTiming" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CheckWorkdayTiming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckTiming_RouteChoice" sourceRef="Task_CheckWorkdayTiming" targetRef="Gateway_RouteChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Home_RouteMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_RouteMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Work_RouteMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_RouteMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RouteMerge_NightRunSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_RouteMerge" targetRef="Gateway_NightRunSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NightRunSplit_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_NightRunSplit" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NightRunSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_NightRunSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_NightRunJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_NightRunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_NightRunJoin" sourceRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" targetRef="Gateway_NightRunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NightRunJoin_CollectFinalTime" sourceRef="Gateway_NightRunJoin" targetRef="Task_CollectFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectFinalTime_Receive" sourceRef="Task_CollectFinalTime" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveFinalTime_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="End_FinalTimeReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
